items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: Oh, yeah, he did some John Wayne films too.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, he did some John Wayne films too.

Dmitri Tiomkin, at the close of his life, I was just starting to have an idea of doing concerts, when Lenny Bernstein had that New York Phil. He talked to me once about, they couldn’t play his music. He had written “West Side Story” and the New York Philharmonic never had played anything with syncopation and time, never. So he said, “Why don’t you start with members of — do a spring season — you know do some concerts. It will help them understand what I’m about, and play whatever music you want. And I did two…
